# XHelpers Pro 1.0.3
**Added** - **Startup & Background Inspector** — Review login items and background agents in one place, with clear links to the matching System Settings controls. - **Memory Health Monitor** — Watch memory pressure and swap activity locally, identify apps using the most memory, and optionally receive sustained-pressure alerts. - **Text Tools and Text Editor** — Transform and review text, edit plain-text and Markdown documents, use split and preview layouts, apply bounded syntax highlighting, and adjust text size. - **Live Translated Subtitles** — Create private, on-device subtitles and translations for a selected browser, with speaker-aware cues and fullscreen-window tracking. Requires macOS 26.4 or later. - **Expanded File and Markdown Viewing** — Open multiple Markdown windows and inspect large text, binary, and hexadecimal files with persistent text-size controls.
**Improved** - **Menu Bar Organization** — A compact two-column menu keeps utilities, screen tools, settings, and actions easier to scan, with keyboard access to its submenus. - **Window Recall and Arrangement** — More reliable window activation, focus verification, snapshot shortcuts, and live Snap & Arrange state. - **Live Subtitle Placement** — Subtitles follow the selected video window across fullscreen Spaces and keep speaker colors and translated lines stable.
**Fixed** - **Snap & Arrange Stability** — The submenu now refreshes in place, opens from the keyboard, and avoids the ownership crash that could occur after rebuilding its contents. - **Editor and Viewer Reliability** — Fixes first-open layouts, narrow panes, search presentation, large-file rendering, and accidental-quit protection for open documents.
Requires macOS 14.0 or later.
